English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us The video linked with the Laggala elephant is AI generated False A video titled 'Operation to rescue the Laggala Elephant' circulating on social media caught the attention of FactSeeker, prompting us to investigate. by Anonymous | October 8, 2024 The captions of the video shared varied such as ‘Sirikotha Elephant Trapped in a Cave’, Provided below are links to such videos: https://www.facebook.com/share/v/RwwDgmcRBjLjm7ZF/ https://www.facebook.com/share/v/DH4gYkZyd9SxhUQb/ At the end of the video, the allegedly rescued elephant appears to be an African elephant while the people gathered around seem to be of Chinese origin. Therefore, it is evident that the video has been created artificially. Running the video through tools such as brandwell.ai and sightengine.com revealed that 90 percent of the video was generated using artificial intelligence (AI). FactSeeker observed that some individuals in the comments sections of the videos shared on social media claimed that video was generated via the use of AI while some seemed to believe that the video was true. Accordingly, FactSeeker confirms that the video circulating captioned ‘Operation to Rescue the Laggala Elephant’ has been created using artificial intelligence, and is therefore, false.
